name: intraday-frontend
description: IntraDay platform frontend. Checkpoint 9: first real screen (read-only configuration viewer) consuming the Checkpoint 8 business API via generated TypeScript contracts. See docs/api/FRONTEND_API_CONSUMPTION.md.

scripts.generate:api:schema: cd .. && poetry run python manage.py spectacular --file openapi.json --format openapi-json --fail-on-warn
scripts.generate:api: npm run generate:api:schema && npm run generate:api:types
